sources: Kennedy, Patrick. Legendary Fictions of the Irish Celts. New York: Benjamin Blom, 1969, 228.
Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: Chlaus Haistig is an Irish heroine from the Fianna legends. A queen suffered constant raids from the Otherworld. A long hairy arm reached into her home. It stole one of her children each time. The queen could not stop it. She asked the hero Fionn Mac Cumhaill for help. She asked that he swear a geis, a sacred vow. Fionn stayed awake through the night. He caught the witch Chlaus Haistig on the roof. The witch had reached down to steal the children. Fionn held her captive. He secured the release of the boys and girls.

okr.objective: Chlaus Haistig tormented an Irish queen of the Fianna legends.
